import re, zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
names = [n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.xml')]
found = set()
for n in names:
    txt = z.read(n).decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
    # strip tags to reassemble text
    stripped = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', txt)
    for m in re.findall(r'\{\{[^}]+\}\}', stripped):
        found.add((n, m))
for f in sorted(found):
    print(f)
EOF

import re, zipfile
from lxml import etree
z = zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
W='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
for n in z.namelist():
    if not n.endswith('.xml'): continue
    root = etree.fromstring(z.read(n))
    for p in root.iter(W+'p'):
        texts = [t.text or '' for t in p.iter(W+'t')]
        joined = ''.join(texts)
        if 'IF_' in joined or 'RELOC' in joined:
            print(n, repr(joined))
EOF
